before: Typing over a range ending inside a prompt replaced the prompt. An explicit left-biased insertion at its leading edge also filled it.
after: Typing, rich paste, tabs, breaks, pictures, and charts preserve an ending unlocked prompt. Optional insertion bias selects an outside position. Local caret metadata retains the side through continued typing and history.
reason: Optional bias fields select local insertion sites. Peers receive canonical tree mutations through the existing transaction journal; they do not replay these operations. Sibling runs, drawings, unchanged prompts, node identities, and stored fields use existing representations. Local caret metadata is not shared or persisted.
